title: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature
raw_excerpt: Google is rolling out its latest AI model, Gemini 4 Carbon, to the general public after releasing it to a select group of "cybersecurity defenders" two weeks ago. Google claims Carbon is its "strongest model" yet, and capable of competing with the very best systems from Anthropic and OpenAI. Google says Gemini 4 Carbon "pushes the frontier even further" than Argon, referring to the company's other frontier model that launched only last month . The company said Argon will likely remain "the ideal choice for the majority of software engineering and knowledge work," but that Carbon is "built for tasks that test the limits of a model's intellige … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Google 正式向公众开放 Gemini 4 Carbon，此前两周仅限网络安全防御者使用。官方称其为「最强模型」，能力对标 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 的旗舰系统，并首次引入 agent「swarm」功能。Carbon 定位超越上月发布的 Argon，后者仍面向多数软件工程与知识工作场景。这是 Google 在前沿模型竞赛中一次重要的正面出牌，值得关注其实际 benchmark 表现与 swarm 的落地方式。

title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
raw_excerpt: AlphaProof Code agents wrote three  million lines of proofs in Lean to verify Signal’s core encryption.
summary: Google DeepMind 发布 AlphaProof Code，其 agent 用 Lean 编写了约三百万行形式化证明，用于验证 Signal 核心加密实现。这是形式化验证在真实工业级软件上的重大突破，把「AI 写证明」从数学竞赛推进到安全关键系统。对密码学、编译器与高可靠性软件工程都有直接意义，也展示了 LLM+形式化方法组合的工程可行性。

title: Anthropic targets $1.4 trillion IPO
raw_excerpt: Anthropic confirmed on Tuesday that its IPO could be one of the biggest ever, even while falling short of previous expectations. Its IPO price is expected to be between $70.00 and $78.00 per share, which would put its valuation as high as $1.4 trillion, according to the The New York Times . The Wall Street Journal reports that according to its sources, Anthropic is "aiming for its shares to start trading Thursday or Friday next week." As Reuters notes, the Anthropic IPO was previously expected to be valued at as much as $2 trillion. As of last week, Anthropic's rival OpenAI was valued at $1.25 trillion . Those lower expectations follow month … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Anthropic 确认启动 IPO，发行价区间 70–78 美元，最高估值约 1.4 万亿美元，预计下周四五开始交易。此前市场预期高达 2 万亿美元，此次定价略有回落，但仍是 AI 行业史上最大上市交易之一。招股文件同时披露七名联合创始人拟套现约 17.5 亿美元。这是 AI 头部实验室资本化进程的标志性事件，将重塑行业估值锚点。

title: Anthropic has its own AI-powered office suite now
raw_excerpt: For years, Anthropic has been known for its focus on enterprise and coding tools that attract high-flying corporate clients, inspiring competing frontier labs - like OpenAI, SpaceXSI, and Meta - to copy its strategies . Earlier this year, Claude Code went through its own particular hype cycle . And now, Anthropic is trying to expand its footprint to other knowledge workers with an AI-powered suite of office tools. At an event in San Francisco on Tuesday, Anthropic unveiled new tools for non-technical workers who spend a lot of time attending meetings, brainstorming new ideas, and analyzing metrics: Claude Meetings, Claude Sheets, and Claude W … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Anthropic 在旧金山发布面向非技术知识工作者的 AI 办公套件，覆盖会议、头脑风暴与材料分析等场景，正式从企业编码工具向通用办公市场扩张。此举直接对标 Microsoft 与 Google 的办公 AI，也延续了 Claude Code 的成功路径。在 IPO 前夕推出，既是产品叙事也是营收故事，值得观察其与 Office Copilot 的差异化竞争。

title: Introducing Meta Ember
raw_excerpt: Meta introduced Muse Ember, a small reasoning model optimized for agent tasks such as tool calling, coding, and document parsing. Meta claims it matches Claude Haiku 5.5's highest reasoning score at roughly one-third the cost and outperforms GPT-6 Luna across reasoning settings.
summary: Meta 发布小型推理模型 Muse Ember，专为工具调用、编码、文档解析等 agent 任务优化。官方称其在最高推理分数上追平 Claude Haiku 5.5，成本约为后者的三分之一，并在多种推理设置下优于 GPT-6 Luna。小模型+低成本+agent 专用是当前明确的产业趋势，若数据属实，将显著压低 agent 工作流的推理成本。

title: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
raw_excerpt: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, featuring improvements in coding, reasoning, and vision, with up to 30% faster output generation and lower pricing. The models share the same underlying architecture.
summary: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5.2 与 Mythos 5.2，两者共享同一底层架构，在编码、推理与视觉能力上均有提升，输出速度最高加快 30% 且价格下调。这是 Claude 系列在 IPO 前的一次重要模型迭代，速度与降价对高频 agent 调用场景影响直接。值得关注其与 Gemini 4 Carbon、Opus 5.5 的实际对比表现。

title: ChatGPT is getting verified AI ‘Business Agents’
raw_excerpt: ChatGPT is going to let you chat with verified "Business Agents" that represent a brand to help you with things like comparison shopping. The feature, available first to "eligible" e-commerce and online service businesses in the US, is launching as part of a suite of business-focused features in ChatGPT being announced today in beta . You can start talking with a Business Agent if a business that has created one appears in a response from ChatGPT. While chatting with a custom agent, you can ask about a business's offerings and ask follow-up questions, like asking about differences between two different products. Businesses can specify a Busi … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 中推出经认证的「Business Agents」，品牌可创建代表自身的 agent，用户可在 ChatGPT 回复中直接与其对话，进行比价购物等交互。该功能先向美国符合条件的电商与在线服务企业开放，属于今日公布的 ChatGPT 企业功能套件 beta 的一部分。这标志着 ChatGPT 从问答入口向商业交易入口延伸，对电商与搜索广告格局有潜在冲击。

title: Google's New TPU Lineup
raw_excerpt: Google introduced TPU 8i Max for massive context windows and higher compute density, alongside TPU 8tx for secure and confidential inference.
summary: Google 发布新一代 TPU 阵容：TPU 8i Max 面向超大上下文窗口与更高算力密度，TPU 8tx 面向安全与机密推理。在算力成为模型竞赛核心瓶颈的当下，自研芯片的迭代节奏直接决定 Gemini 系列的成本与供给能力。8tx 强调机密推理，也回应了企业对数据隐私的诉求，是基础设施层面的关键信号。

title: GR00T 2
raw_excerpt: GR00T 2 is a new generation of foundation world-action models that can predict future video and robot actions together.
summary: NVIDIA 研究团队发布 GR00T 2，这是新一代基础 world-action 模型，可同时预测未来视频与机器人动作。相比纯 VLA 模型，联合视频预测让机器人具备更强的环境动态建模能力，是具身智能从「动作克隆」走向「世界模型驱动」的重要一步。对机器人基础模型的架构选择与训练范式都有参考价值。

title: NVIDIA Introduces Hardware-Aware LLM Compression
raw_excerpt: NVIDIA's AutoCompress framework optimizes LLM pruning for hardware-specific latency, throughput, and memory constraints rather than parameter counts alone. It compressed Nemotron 3.5 Super from 120B to 74B parameters while retaining its performance.
summary: NVIDIA 提出 AutoCompress 框架，按硬件实际的延迟、吞吐与内存约束优化 LLM 剪枝，而非只看参数量。实验中把 Nemotron 3.5 Super 从 120B 压缩到 74B 并保持性能。这提示模型压缩正从「参数越少越好」转向「硬件感知的端到端效率」，对推理部署成本有直接意义，也为剪枝研究提供了新的评价维度。
